# Local catalog and audit helpers
Python 3.9+ standard library only. No network, databases, UI or third-party dependencies.

Code modules: `catalog` owns product queries and existing receipt formatting; `audit` owns audit summaries. Neither calls the other. `shared` holds the existing receipt formatter used by catalog.
Public legacy functions must keep their behaviour.

Run all tests from the repository root with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`. Tests may be added for a change.

import copy
import unittest
from src.audit.summary import event_snapshot

def event(id="e1", kind="login", timestamp="2026-01-02T03:04:05Z", **extra):
    item = {"id": id, "kind": kind, "timestamp": timestamp}
    item.update(extra)
    return item

def reasons(result):
    return [(error["index"], error["reason"]) for error in result["errors"]]

class EventSnapshotTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_result_shape_order_and_counts(self):
        result = event_snapshot([event("c", "Login"), event("a", "logout"), event("b", "Login")])
        self.assertEqual(set(result), {"counts", "accepted_ids", "errors"})
        self.assertEqual(result["accepted_ids"], ["c", "a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(result["counts"], {"Login": 2, "logout": 1})
        self.assertEqual(result["errors"], [])
        self.assertEqual(event_snapshot([]), {"counts": {}, "accepted_ids": [], "errors": []})

    def test_invalid_id(self):
        result = event_snapshot([event(""), event(3), event(None), event(" ")])
        self.assertEqual(reasons(result), [(0, "invalid_id"), (1, "invalid_id"), (2, "invalid_id")])
        self.assertEqual(result["accepted_ids"], [" "])

    def test_invalid_kind(self):
        result = event_snapshot([event("a", ""), event("b", 1), event("c", None), event("d", " x ")])
        self.assertEqual(reasons(result), [(0, "invalid_kind"), (1, "invalid_kind"), (2, "invalid_kind")])
        self.assertEqual(result["counts"], {" x ": 1})

    def test_invalid_timestamp_forms(self):
        bad = ["", "2026-01-02 03:04:05Z", "2026-01-02T03:04:05", "2026-01-02T03:04:05z",
               "2026-01-02T03:04:05+00:00", "2026-01-02T03:04:05.1Z", "2026-1-02T03:04:05Z",
               " 2026-01-02T03:04:05Z", "2026-01-02T03:04:05Z\n", "２026-01-02T03:04:05Z",
               "2026-02-30T00:00:00Z", "2025-02-29T00:00:00Z", "2026-13-01T00:00:00Z",
               "2026-00-10T00:00:00Z", "2026-01-00T00:00:00Z", "2026-01-01T24:00:00Z",
               "2026-01-01T23:60:00Z", "2026-01-01T23:59:60Z", "0000-01-01T00:00:00Z",
               None, 20260102, b"2026-01-02T03:04:05Z"]
        result = event_snapshot([event(str(i), "k", value) for i, value in enumerate(bad)])
        self.assertEqual(reasons(result), [(i, "invalid_timestamp") for i in range(len(bad))])
        ok = event_snapshot([event("leap", "k", "2024-02-29T23:59:59Z")])
        self.assertEqual(ok["accepted_ids"], ["leap"])

    def test_first_error_only(self):
        result = event_snapshot([
            {"id": "", "kind": "", "timestamp": "bad"},
            {"id": "a", "kind": "", "timestamp": "bad"},
            {"id": "a", "kind": "k", "timestamp": "bad"},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(reasons(result), [(0, "invalid_id"), (1, "invalid_kind"), (2, "invalid_timestamp")])

    def test_window_inclusive_bounds(self):
        start, end = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-01-31T23:59:59Z"
        result = event_snapshot([event("s", "k", start), event("m", "k", "2026-01-15T12:00:00Z"),
                                 event("e", "k", end)], start, end)
        self.assertEqual(result["accepted_ids"], ["s", "m", "e"])
        same = event_snapshot([event("x", "k", start), event("y", "k", end)], start, start)
        self.assertEqual(same["accepted_ids"], ["x"])

    def test_out_of_window_not_errors(self):
        start, end = "2026-01-10T00:00:00Z", "2026-01-20T00:00:00Z"
        result = event_snapshot([event("before", "k", "2026-01-09T23:59:59Z"),
                                 event("after", "k", "2026-01-20T00:00:01Z"),
                                 event("bad", "k", "2026-02-30T00:00:00Z")], start, end)
        self.assertEqual(result["accepted_ids"], [])
        self.assertEqual(result["counts"], {})
        self.assertEqual(reasons(result), [(2, "invalid_timestamp")])

    def test_single_sided_bounds(self):
        events = [event("old", "k", "1999-12-31T23:59:59Z"), event("new", "k", "2030-01-01T00:00:00Z")]
        self.assertEqual(event_snapshot(events, start="2000-01-01T00:00:00Z")["accepted_ids"], ["new"])
        self.assertEqual(event_snapshot(events, end="2000-01-01T00:00:00Z")["accepted_ids"], ["old"])
        self.assertEqual(event_snapshot(events)["accepted_ids"], ["old", "new"])

    def test_invalid_or_out_of_window_does_not_claim_id(self):
        start, end = "2026-01-10T00:00:00Z", "2026-01-20T00:00:00Z"
        result = event_snapshot([
            event("a", "first", "not-a-time"),
            event("a", "", "2026-01-15T00:00:00Z"),
            event("b", "early", "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
            event("a", "view", "2026-01-15T00:00:00Z"),
            event("b", "view", "2026-01-12T00:00:00Z"),
        ], start, end)
        self.assertEqual(result["accepted_ids"], ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(result["counts"], {"view": 2})
        self.assertEqual(reasons(result), [(0, "invalid_timestamp"), (1, "invalid_kind")])

    def test_later_duplicate_ignored_even_other_kind(self):
        result = event_snapshot([event("a", "login"), event("b", "login"), event("a", "logout"),
                                 event("a", "login"), event("a", "")])
        self.assertEqual(result["accepted_ids"], ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(result["counts"], {"login": 2})
        self.assertEqual(reasons(result), [(4, "invalid_kind")])

    def test_no_mutation_and_repeatable(self):
        events = [event("a"), event("a", "other"), event("", "k"), event("b", "k", "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z")]
        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(events)
        first = event_snapshot(events, "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z")
        second = event_snapshot(events, "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z")
        self.assertEqual(events, snapshot)
        self.assertEqual(first, second)
        first["counts"]["login"] = 99
        first["accepted_ids"].append("leak")
        self.assertEqual(event_snapshot(events, "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"), second)

    def test_missing_fields_and_extras(self):
        full = event()
        expected = {"id": "invalid_id", "kind": "invalid_kind", "timestamp": "invalid_timestamp"}
        for field, reason in expected.items():
            item = {k: v for k, v in full.items() if k != field}
            self.assertEqual(reasons(event_snapshot([item])), [(0, reason)], field)
        self.assertEqual(event_snapshot([event(note="x", kind="k")]), event_snapshot([event(kind="k")]))

import unittest
from src.catalog.query import receipt_for, all_product_ids, product_snapshot
from src.audit.summary import legacy_summary, event_snapshot
from src.shared.formatting import RECEIPT_LENGTH

class PreservedBehaviourTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_receipt_not_shortened_by_label(self):
        reference = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP"
        label = product_snapshot([{"id": reference, "name": reference, "active": True,
                                   "category": "", "price": "1"}])["products"][0]["label"]
        self.assertEqual(label, "ABCDEFGH")
        self.assertEqual(RECEIPT_LENGTH, 12)
        self.assertEqual(receipt_for(reference), "receipt:ABCDEFGHIJKL")

    def test_legacy_functions_unchanged_alongside_snapshots(self):
        items = [{"id": "a", "name": "n", "active": True, "category": "", "price": "1"},
                 {"id": "b", "name": "n", "active": False, "category": "", "price": "1"},
                 {"id": "a", "name": "n", "active": True, "category": "", "price": "1"}]
        events = [{"id": "x", "kind": "k", "timestamp": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"},
                  {"id": "x", "kind": "k", "timestamp": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}]
        product_snapshot(items)
        event_snapshot(events)
        self.assertEqual(all_product_ids(items), ["a", "b", "a"])
        self.assertEqual(legacy_summary(events), {"total": 2})
        self.assertEqual(event_snapshot(events)["accepted_ids"], ["x"])

import copy
import decimal
import unittest
from src.catalog.query import product_snapshot

def product(**overrides):
    item = {"id": "p1", "name": "Widget", "active": True, "category": "tools", "price": "1.50"}
    item.update(overrides)
    return item

def reasons(result):
    return [(error["index"], error["reason"]) for error in result["errors"]]

class ProductSnapshotTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_result_shape_and_input_order(self):
        result = product_snapshot([product(id="b"), product(id="a"), product(id="c")])
        self.assertEqual(set(result), {"products", "errors"})
        self.assertEqual([p["id"] for p in result["products"]], ["b", "a", "c"])
        self.assertEqual(result["errors"], [])

    def test_duplicate_ids_are_kept(self):
        result = product_snapshot([product(id="a"), product(id="a", name="Other")])
        self.assertEqual([p["id"] for p in result["products"]], ["a", "a"])

    def test_invalid_id(self):
        result = product_snapshot([product(id=""), product(id=7), product(id=None), product(id=" ")])
        self.assertEqual(reasons(result), [(0, "invalid_id"), (1, "invalid_id"), (2, "invalid_id")])
        self.assertEqual([p["id"] for p in result["products"]], [" "])

    def test_invalid_name(self):
        result = product_snapshot([product(name=None), product(name=5), product(name="")])
        self.assertEqual(reasons(result), [(0, "invalid_name"), (1, "invalid_name")])
        self.assertEqual(len(result["products"]), 1)

    def test_invalid_active_rejects_int(self):
        result = product_snapshot([product(active=1), product(active=0), product(active="true"), product(active=False)])
        self.assertEqual(reasons(result), [(0, "invalid_active"), (1, "invalid_active"), (2, "invalid_active")])
        self.assertEqual(result["products"], [])

    def test_invalid_category(self):
        result = product_snapshot([product(category=None), product(category=3), product(category="")])
        self.assertEqual(reasons(result), [(0, "invalid_category"), (1, "invalid_category")])
        self.assertEqual(len(result["products"]), 1)

    def test_invalid_price_forms(self):
        bad = ["", "1.", ".5", "1.234", "+1", "-1", " 1", "1 ", "1\n", "1e2", "1E2", "1,00",
               "１", "١", "NaN", "inf", 1, 1.5, None, decimal.Decimal("1")]
        result = product_snapshot([product(price=value) for value in bad])
        self.assertEqual(reasons(result), [(i, "invalid_price") for i in range(len(bad))])
        self.assertEqual(result["products"], [])

    def test_first_error_only(self):
        result = product_snapshot([
            {"id": "", "name": 1, "active": 1, "category": 1, "price": "x"},
            {"id": "a", "name": 1, "active": 1, "category": 1, "price": "x"},
            {"id": "a", "name": "n", "active": 1, "category": 1, "price": "x"},
            {"id": "a", "name": "n", "active": True, "category": 1, "price": "x"},
            {"id": "a", "name": "n", "active": True, "category": "c", "price": "x"},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(reasons(result), [
            (0, "invalid_id"), (1, "invalid_name"), (2, "invalid_active"),
            (3, "invalid_category"), (4, "invalid_price"),
        ])

    def test_decimal_context_unchanged(self):
        context = decimal.getcontext()
        before = (context.prec, context.rounding, dict(context.traps), dict(context.flags))
        product_snapshot([product(price="001.2"), product(price="9" * 60 + ".99"), product(price="1e5")])
        after = decimal.getcontext()
        self.assertIs(after, context)
        self.assertEqual((after.prec, after.rounding, dict(after.traps), dict(after.flags)), before)

    def test_inactive_valid_item_skipped(self):
        result = product_snapshot([product(id="off", active=False), product(id="on")])
        self.assertEqual([p["id"] for p in result["products"]], ["on"])
        self.assertEqual(result["errors"], [])

    def test_category_exact_filter(self):
        items = [product(id="a", category="tools"), product(id="b", category="Tools"),
                 product(id="c", category="tools "), product(id="d", category=""), product(id="e", category="tools")]
        self.assertEqual([p["id"] for p in product_snapshot(items, "tools")["products"]], ["a", "e"])
        self.assertEqual([p["id"] for p in product_snapshot(items, "")["products"]], ["d"])
        self.assertEqual(len(product_snapshot(items)["products"]), 5)

    def test_invalid_items_reported_despite_filters(self):
        items = [product(id="ok"), product(active=False, price="bad"),
                 product(category="other", name=None), product(active=False, category="other", id="")]
        result = product_snapshot(items, "tools")
        self.assertEqual([p["id"] for p in result["products"]], ["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(reasons(result), [(1, "invalid_price"), (2, "invalid_name"), (3, "invalid_id")])

    def test_label_and_price_example(self):
        result = product_snapshot([product(id="x", name="ABCDEFGHIJK", price="001.2")])
        self.assertEqual(result["products"], [{"id": "x", "label": "ABCDEFGH", "price": "1.20"}])

    def test_empty_name_and_zero_price(self):
        result = product_snapshot([product(name="", price="0"), product(name="一二三四五六七八九", price="000.05"),
                                   product(name="ab", price="12.3"), product(name="ab", price="7.00"),
                                   product(name="ab", price="1234567890123456789012345")])
        self.assertEqual([(p["label"], p["price"]) for p in result["products"]], [
            ("", "0.00"), ("一二三四五六七八", "0.05"), ("ab", "12.30"), ("ab", "7.00"),
            ("ab", "1234567890123456789012345.00"),
        ])

    def test_output_keys_exact(self):
        result = product_snapshot([product(extra="ignored")])
        self.assertEqual(list(result["products"][0]), ["id", "label", "price"])

    def test_no_mutation_and_repeatable(self):
        items = [product(id="a"), product(id="b", active=False), product(id="", price="x")]
        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(items)
        first = product_snapshot(items, "tools")
        second = product_snapshot(items, "tools")
        self.assertEqual(items, snapshot)
        self.assertEqual(first, second)
        first["products"].append("leak")
        first["errors"].clear()
        self.assertEqual(product_snapshot(items, "tools"), second)

    def test_missing_fields_and_extras(self):
        full = product()
        expected = {"id": "invalid_id", "name": "invalid_name", "active": "invalid_active",
                    "category": "invalid_category", "price": "invalid_price"}
        for field, reason in expected.items():
            item = {k: v for k, v in full.items() if k != field}
            self.assertEqual(reasons(product_snapshot([item])), [(0, reason)], field)
        self.assertEqual(product_snapshot([product(extra=1, id="z")]), product_snapshot([product(id="z")]))
